title: Cross Stitch&Needlepoint Game
shortDescription: Colour pixel art patterns stitch by stitch in a calm, offline craft game
fullDescription:
Stitch Wish turns any photo into a relaxing cross stitch pattern you can play, no needle required.

Browse a growing catalog of ready-to-stitch patterns, or turn your own photos into a Personal Pattern with a few taps. Prefer something imaginative? Generate original AI artwork and convert it into a pattern of your own.

Stitch at your own pace on an accessible, numbered grid designed for both quick sessions and long relaxing ones. Your progress saves locally as you go and syncs to your account, so you can pick up right where you left off on any device.

Earn Stitch Coin as you play and spend it to unlock more patterns from the catalog. Join Premium Membership for exclusive themes and a daily coin claim, or pick up AI Credit to generate more artwork whenever inspiration strikes.

Love a pattern you've made? Submit it to the community catalog for other stitchers to enjoy, complete with real DMC thread colour references for anyone who wants to stitch it with actual needle and thread.

Cross stitch, reimagined for your pocket: soothing, creative, and yours to shape.
